rule.question: is there any bed under custody where a write restriction could clear the SESOI at all
rule.screen: on training source groups only, measure the oracle ceiling, meaning the mean per unit best of the two writers minus the unrestricted control. A bed is a candidate only if the lower 95 percent bound of that ceiling exceeds the SESOI

excluded.har_stream: classified an invalid principal bed by the fast state reaudit
excluded.speech_stream: classified an invalid principal bed by the fast state reaudit

rule.outcome_if_none_clears: the finding is that no bed under custody can test H_typed_workspace at the declared effect size. That is a mapped boundary and not a null, and the SESOI is not lowered to manufacture a candidate
rule.prior_measurement: the harth_stream ceiling of 0.036124 was measured by SX1b before this rule was written and is carried forward unchanged rather than remeasured

finding: no bed under custody can test H_typed_workspace at the declared SESOI of 0.05. The hypothesis stays untested and the SESOI stays where it was preregistered
not_a_null: a hypothesis nothing can currently measure is untested, not refuted. Nothing downstream of H_typed_workspace closes
